role: compact receipt for the user-requested VIFstep<=10 comparative reanalysis on the native-only Chapter 1 cohort

v2_scale_structure_reconfirmed.within_taxon: taxon-demeaned standardized univariate slope with taxon-clustered uncertainty; circular traits use the registered joint sine/cosine test with predictor permutations within taxon
v2_scale_structure_reconfirmed.among_taxon: taxon-level trait medians and taxon-level environment medians; standardized univariate slope with predictor permutation across taxa; primary min5 and sensitivity min2 scopes retained
v2_scale_structure_reconfirmed.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg families remain separate for within taxon, among min5 and among min2
v2_scale_structure_reconfirmed.conclusion: Frozen v2 explicitly separated within-taxon and among-taxon inference; this distinction is not introduced by v3.

vifstep_filter.provenance: The frozen v2 primary atlas did not use VIF for predictor selection. This is a user-requested comparative specification applied before rerunning the same v2 marginal models.
vifstep_filter.rule: Within each scale, iteratively remove the predictor with the current maximum VIF while max(VIF)>10; stop when all retained predictors have VIF<=10. Trait outcomes do not enter selection.

orientation_boundary.orientation_bio01: Not tested in the VIFstep<=10 lane because BIO1 is removed by the phenotype-blind VIF filter.
orientation_boundary.orientation_bio12: BIO12 remains in the retained predictor set, but the previously observed positive association still does not pass the existing broad-spatial sensitivity because residual spatial autocorrelation remains detectable (native nine-predictor receipt Moran p=0.008). VIF filtering does not rescue it.

interpretation.primary_result: After native-range restriction and phenotype-blind VIFstep<=10 filtering, the strongest among-taxon results surviving BH-FDR, the existing broad-spatial sensitivity and all 52 historical-placement trees remain visible corolla chroma: lower chroma with higher shortwave radiation and higher chroma with higher NPP.
interpretation.descriptive_result: Two yellow-pixel-fraction associations also pass the same gates, but the colour fractions form a closed composition and remain descriptive rather than independent primary biological discoveries.
interpretation.model_boundary: VIF is used here only to filter the family of marginal univariate tests. The downstream v2 estimators are not converted into a simultaneous multivariable regression.

claim_boundary: This VIF-filtered lane is comparative and was not the frozen v2 primary specification.
VIF filtering does not by itself make marginal environmental associations causal or independent effects.
Broad-spatial sensitivity is not a full SPDE spatial-process model.
Historical-placement sensitivity uses grafted placement trees and is not a resolved Cirsium species-tree correction.
Survival through these gates does not establish adaptation, selection, convergence or mechanism.
